```artifact
Use-Cases & User Stories for VIRTUA-2.5-18, VIRTUA-2.5-19, VIRTUA-2.5-20, VIRTUA-2.6-1, VIRTUA-2.6-2

Use-Case 1: Simple System Navigation for Non-Computer Background Users
Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User accesses system, navigates easily
Alternative Flow: User asks for help, receives guidance
Exception Flow: User cannot find a feature, receives assistance

Use-Case 2: Quick Consultation Request
Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User fills out minimal questions, submits request
Alternative Flow: User takes longer to fill out questions
Exception Flow: User cannot submit request

Use-Case 3: Installation Guide
Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User follows installation guide, installs system
Alternative Flow: User skips steps, installs incorrectly
Exception Flow: User cannot install system

Use-Case 4: User Manual for End Users
Actor: Non-Computer Background User
Main Flow: User reads manual, understands system
Alternative Flow: User finds manual confusing, seeks clarification
Exception Flow: User misinterprets manual

```
